researcher_notes: Checked the existing roster: no row for this lateral. The only Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America rows are the system row P0222 and the Texas-Louisiana Expansion row P7832, so this is not a match. Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America built a new 47 mile, 24 inch lateral from Centralia to the East St. Louis market in Illinois, anchored by Illinois Power and Dynegy, for about 300,000 Dth per day. The EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026 (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 251) lists it as completed in September 2002, 47 miles, 24 inches, 300 MMcf/d, 37 million dollars. An Oil and Gas Journal article and a Natural Gas Intelligence article from 2001 give the same length, diameter, route ends and a 35 million dollar estimate, so the cost shown is EIA's completed figure. Length is 76 km, above the 25 km rule. Proposal year 2001 is inferred from the 2001 announcement articles. Capacity in the EIA table is the added capacity. Owner is spelled as the source spells it, because the owner gazetteer only has a fuzzy match (Natural Gas Pipeline Co of America LLC (NGPL)); a person should confirm the team spelling. Start and end are named towns from the articles, no map source found. No route was researched; route is unavailable. Docket number is not given in EIA (na).
